note: EN CHOMREY Day 03 (owner, 14 Nov 2026): '3 mistakes that make businesses lose money on Ads'. Khmer voice-over, Kiri Bora, one take per scene; nothing is posted.

host.instruction: Curious, confident marketing expert with a surprising hook, natural pace, short pause after the question

lines.text: ចាយលុយលើ Ads រាល់ខែ, តែលុយបាត់ ដោយមិនដឹងថាទៅណា?
lines.instruction: Curious, confident marketing expert with a surprising hook, natural pace, short pause after the ques

lines.text: ម្ចាស់អាជីវកម្មជាច្រើន ខាតលុយលើ Ads, ដោយសារ ៣ កំហុសនេះ។
lines.instruction: Calm, confident expert introducing a common problem, clear, medium pace

lines.text: កំហុសទីមួយ៖ គ្មានគោលដៅច្បាស់។ មិនដឹងថាចង់បាន Message, ឬចង់បាន Order។
lines.instruction: Analytical expert counting mistakes, clear numbers, short pause after each mistake

lines.text: កំហុសទីពីរ៖ ដាក់ Ads ទៅមនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា, ជំនួសឲ្យអតិថិជនដែលត្រូវគោលដៅ។
lines.instruction: Analytical expert counting mistakes, clear numbers, short pause after each mistake

lines.text: កំហុសទីបី៖ មិនវាស់លទ្ធផល, ហើយបន្តចាយលុយដដែលៗ។
lines.instruction: Analytical expert counting mistakes, clear numbers, short pause after each mistake

lines.text: ដូច្នេះ មុនចាយលុយ, កំណត់គោលដៅមួយ, ជ្រើស Audience ឲ្យត្រូវ, ហើយពិនិត្យលទ្ធផលរាល់ថ្ងៃ។
lines.instruction: Helpful expert giving practical steps, confident, warm, medium pace

lines.text: អ្នកធ្លាប់ជួបកំហុសមួយណា? Comment លេខ ១ ២ ឬ ៣ ហើយ Follow EN CHOMREY។
lines.instruction: Friendly, confident invitation to comment and follow, warm, not salesy
